description: One reusable parent-account hook for every product: sign in through the parent identity (code + PKCE + state + nonce), server-side exchange with local ES256 verification, minimal on-device profile, framework-agnostic store + React hook factory, and per-product design templates (Hebrew labels, contrast-checked colors). Off by default: console module 'account' per product, and the product server stays not_configured until its client secret exists. Visible UI is a separate console module 'account-ui' (depends on 'account'): accountUiVisible(modules) gates the button; off by default, so a product can be connected in the background with nothing visible.
dataPolicy: Browser keeps only { sub (pairwise per product), masked email hint, verified, licensed } under pa:<product>:*; no tokens, no full email. Product data never leaves the device.
